name: dumbbell side lunge
description: A lateral lunge with dumbbells that trains the glutes, quads and inner thighs in the frontal plane.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand or one at your chest and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest upright.
Push through the bent leg to return to the middle.
Alternate sides or finish all reps on one side before switching.
